extractor.#: Everything lands in ~/Manga, which the shell's manga reader (/manga) reads.
extractor.#archive: Remembers what was downloaded, so running the same URL again only fetches new chapters (the images themselves are gone once zipped).
extractor.#sleep: Be gentle with the sites: a short random pause between requests.
extractor.#manga: Any site whose chapters come with a manga name and a chapter number: ~/Manga/<Series>/c0012 Title.cbz. Everything else keeps gallery-dl's own layout.

mangadex.#group: Two groups can translate the same chapter: their names keep the files apart.
mangadex.#covers: A series URL also fetches the cover art, for the reader's library.
mangadex.#covers-lang: Covers are tagged with the original's language (usually ja), so 'en' above would find none.

cbz.name: zip
cbz.#mode: safe = the .cbz is closed after every page, so a download stopped mid-chapter leaves a readable file that resuming finishes.
cbz.filter: manga and chapter is not None

postprocessor.#doujin: For /doujin <url> (manga.py passes these, plus the doujin folder and '<id> <title>' naming): the gallery's details as info.json, packed into its .cbz with the pages, for the doujin library's tags / artist / language filters.
postprocessor.#source: For update checks: when the reader starts a download, the series folder notes that URL in .source. Does nothing otherwise.

source.name: exec
source.filter: manga and chapter is not None
